vb_textbox.text: Ignore the colours of the gnomes. Instead, pay attention to their hat shapes, as this determines which forest they send you to.To start, select a gnome. If it gives you a forest with 5 or more mushrooms, then on the next trial select the gnome with the same hat shape. If the first gnome gives fewer than 5 mushrooms, then next time, select then gnome with the other hat shape.Keep selecting gnomes of the same hat shape until you get 3 or fewer mushrooms for 2 consecutive trials. Then start selecting the gnomes with the other hat shape as this should now yeild high mushrooms. Repeat this process.At some point both forests will yield low mushrooms, and when this happens, alternate between them until one starts performing better (at least 4 mushrooms).Each forest will yield between 0-9 mushrooms on each trial. The method above gave roughly 1100 mushrooms.
